product_metadata.title: Organize It All Cabinet Door Lid Organizer | 6 Sections | Wall or Pantry Door Mount | Non Scratch Coating | Pots and Container Lids | White
features: Constructed from sturdy heavy weight metal
Non scratch coating protects stored pot lids from being damaged
Organizes pot lids and container lids
Saves space in cabinets and pantries by utilizing unused space behind doors
Product Dimensions: Length: 10.62” x Width: 4” x Height: 16.62”
description: Making one of the hardest kitchen items to store a simple task now. The Organize It All 6 Section Cabinet Door Lid Rack allows you to easily store pot lids out of the way but with easy access. It takes up less space than in a drawer and you can easily find the lid you are looking for. Declutter the kitchen by simply mounting this rack to the cabinet.
